title: Reconstruction from a nonempty first projection
statement: Let $z$ be a finite Boolean word whose total first projection under the pairing parser is nonempty. Then $z$ is the pairing of its total first and second projections, using the encoding that doubles every bit of the first word, appends the separator $01$, and then appends the second word.
hypotheses_covered: The total first projection of $z$ is nonempty
